projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
A new analytics dashboard project that unifies three data workstreams: (1) data processing of customer CSV files, (2) log analysis of application logs, and (3) visualization components that surface insights to end users. Goal: build a maintainable, well-structured dashboard with clear milestones and tasks broken down to manageable execution size.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-processing, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: Milestone 1: Customer CSV Data Processing Pipeline
tasks.details: Coordination container for the customer CSV data processing workstream. All execution work is delegated to its 6 child tasks (schema/data contract, ingestion, validation, cleaning, transformation, load), each complexity ≤6. This milestone tracks progress and integration of those tasks rather than being executed as a single unit.

tasks.name: Milestone 2: Application Log Analysis
tasks.details: Coordination container for the application log analysis workstream. All execution work is delegated to its 5 child tasks (log format requirements, ingestion, parsing/normalization, metric extraction, aggregation/storage), each complexity ≤6. This milestone tracks progress and integration of those tasks rather than being executed as a single unit.

tasks.name: Milestone 3: Visualization Components
tasks.details: Coordination container for the visualization components workstream. All execution work is delegated to its 6 child tasks (UI scaffold, data access/API layer, core chart components, customer data views, log analytics views, interactive filtering), each complexity ≤6. This milestone tracks progress and integration of those tasks rather than being executed as a single unit.

tasks.name: Milestone 4: Integration, Testing & Deployment
tasks.details: Coordination container for the integration, testing and deployment workstream. All execution work is delegated to its 4 child tasks (end-to-end integration, automated test suite, CI/CD setup, production deployment and monitoring), each complexity ≤6. This milestone tracks progress and release readiness rather than being executed as a single unit.

tasks.name: Define CSV schema and data contract
tasks.details: Document the expected customer CSV columns, data types, required vs optional fields, and validation rules. Produce a data contract used later by ingestion and cleaning tasks.

tasks.name: Build CSV ingestion module
tasks.details: Implement a module that reads customer CSV files from the source location, handles encoding and delimiters, and streams rows into the processing pipeline.

tasks.name: Implement schema validation and error handling
tasks.details: Validate each CSV row against the data contract. Collect and report invalid rows, and define error handling for malformed files.

tasks.name: Build data cleaning and normalization
tasks.details: Implement cleaning steps: deduplication, trimming, type coercion, null handling, and normalization of customer fields into consistent formats.

tasks.name: Transform into analytics-ready datasets
tasks.details: Apply business transformations and aggregations to turn cleaned customer data into datasets used by dashboard visualizations (e.g., per-customer metrics, segments).

tasks.name: Load processed customer data into data store
tasks.details: Persist transformed customer datasets into the dashboard's data store (database/warehouse) with idempotent, re-runnable loads.

tasks.name: Define log formats and parsing requirements
tasks.details: Document application log formats (structured/unstructured), fields to extract, and the parsing rules and target schema.

tasks.name: Build log ingestion module
tasks.details: Implement a module that collects application log files/streams, handles rotation and large volumes, and feeds records into the parsing stage.

tasks.name: Implement log parsing and normalization
tasks.details: Parse log lines into structured records, extract timestamps, levels, messages, and context fields, and normalize formats into a common schema.

tasks.name: Extract metrics and events from logs
tasks.details: Derive metrics and events from parsed logs such as error rates, request latency, throughput, and notable event patterns for dashboarding.

tasks.name: Aggregate and store log analytics results
tasks.details: Aggregate extracted log metrics over time windows and persist them into the data store for use by visualization components.

tasks.name: Scaffold dashboard UI and layout
tasks.details: Set up the frontend application shell, routing, base layout, and reusable UI primitives (header, nav, grid, cards) for the analytics dashboard.

tasks.name: Build data access / API layer for the UI
tasks.details: Create the API/service layer that the frontend uses to query customer datasets and log analytics from the data store, including pagination and caching.

tasks.name: Build core chart components
tasks.details: Implement reusable chart components (line, bar, pie, KPI cards) that accept typed data props and render consistently across the dashboard.

tasks.name: Integrate customer data views
tasks.details: Build the dashboard views that visualize processed customer CSV data (customer metrics, segments) using the chart components and data API.

tasks.name: Integrate log analytics views
tasks.details: Build the dashboard views that visualize log analytics (error rates, latency, throughput) using the chart components and data API.

tasks.name: Add interactive filtering and controls
tasks.details: Add date-range pickers, filters, and drill-down controls that let users interact with customer and log data views.

tasks.name: End-to-end integration of pipelines and UI
tasks.details: Wire the CSV pipeline, log pipeline, and dashboard UI together so data flows end-to-end from sources to visualizations in a single running system.

tasks.name: Automated test suite (unit + integration)
tasks.details: Write unit tests for pipelines and components plus integration tests covering data flow from CSV/log sources to dashboard views.

tasks.name: Set up CI/CD pipeline
tasks.details: Configure continuous integration to run tests/linting on every change and a deployment job to release the dashboard to staging/production.

tasks.name: Production deployment and monitoring
tasks.details: Deploy the dashboard to the production environment and set up monitoring, alerting, and health checks for pipelines and UI.
